verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਕਾਮ ਚੇਸਟਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਜਤ ਸਤਵੰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhuramat gurmat sa(n)gat asaadh saadh kaam chesaTaa sa(n)jog jat satava(n)t hai ||

en.bdb: The impure intelligence and company of evil persons generates lust and passion but adopting the teachings of True Guru, makes a person disciplined and chaste.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੇ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੈ ਸਹਜ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਮੋਖ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰੰਤਰ ਧਰਮ ਧੀਰ ਜੰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: krodh ke birodh bikhai sahaj sa(n)tokh mokh lobh lahara(n)tar dharam dheer ja(n)t hai ||

en.bdb: The impure wisdom entangles a person in the waves of hatred and greed under the influence of anger, whereas in the company of saints he attains, humility, patience and kindness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੈ ਅਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਰਥ ਸੈ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਟੇਵ ਦਇਆ ਦ੍ਰਵੀਭੂਤ ਸੰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: maiaa moh dhroh kai arath pramaarath sai aha(n)mev Tev dhiaa dhraveebhoot sa(n)t hai ||

en.bdb: A person with base wisdom is ever engrossed in the love of maya (mammon). He becomes deceitful and arrogant. But with the intellect of the True Guru, one becomes clement, kind, humble and saintly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਚਿਤ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਅਉ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੂਲ ਮੰਤ ਹੈ ॥੧੭੭॥
verses.translit_en: dhukirat sukirat chit mitr satrataa subhaav paraupakaar aau bikaar mool ma(n)t hai ||177||

en.bdb: One with impure intellect remains absorbed in base deeds and is ridden with animosity, whereas a Guru-conscious person is friendly and of good dispositions. The welfare of everyone is his/her mission in life. (177)
